stories.title: Iran war supercharges pivot to renewable energy
stories.description: The Iran war and high oil and gas prices have supercharged the adoption of renewables and EVs worldwide. Global investors say these technologies make financial sense and increase energy security.

stories.title: U.S. and Iran exchange fire despite ceasefire. And, Trump nominates a new head of ICE
stories.description: The U.S. and Iran exchanged strikes over the weekend, putting their latest ceasefire in jeopardy. And, Trump has nominated a former Oklahoma state trooper to head Immigration and Customs Enforcement.

stories.title: Trump says the U.S. and Iran will meet in Qatar after weekend attacks
stories.description: President Trump said talks with Iran would resume Tuesday in Qatar, despite the two sides trading attacks in the Gulf over the weekend. Iran did not confirm whether it will participate.

stories.title: Former Iran nuclear deal negotiator on what U.S.-Iran 'new normal' looks like

stories.title: US says it has agreed to 'stand down' after exchange of strikes with Iran

stories.title: Live: In south Lebanon, Netanyahu says Israel will stay as long as Hezbollah ‘threatens us’
Ceasefire brings respite from war but not an end to hardships for Lebanese
stories.description: After months of war, a ceasefire with Israel has brought a period of respite to Lebanon. But it has not made the hardships of daily life disappear. Uncertainty, inflation and poverty remain. In the face of these challenges, solidarity also continues to play an essential role.

stories.title: Iran to hold talks with Qatar on MoU deal with US, frozen assets

stories.title: US envoys in Doha for indirect talks with Iranian technical delegation
